Quick summary of what we need to determine 1099 and withholding status: 
- If Novaresellers US, Inc. is the payee on the invoice and is a US taxpayer, we need a completed W-9 (signed, with EIN) for 1099 reporting.
- If the foreign parent (Novaresellers LLC, Mexico) is the payee, we typically need a signed W-8BEN-E and the chapters of tax treaty / FATCA status so we can determine withholding.
- For reseller arrangements, we also need clarity on whether the services were performed inside the US and which legal entity contracted with Redwood.

Can you confirm which legal entity to pay (US or MX entity) and send the appropriate signed form. If you prefer DocuSign for the W-9/W-8, we can send a link. Also if you can attach an ACH authorization (bank details) we can expedite once forms are validated.

Hi Sofia — thanks for sending the certificate and invoice. A few notes from Finance on process and exact docs we need to clear payment: 

Required (choose one path depending on payee):
- If payee = Novaresellers US, Inc. (US corporation): signed W-9 (PDF), copy of the US EIN letter (IRS CP 575 or equivalent), and completed ACH_authorization_form.pdf. With those we can process and 1099 as required.
- If payee = Novaresellers LLC (Mexican entity): signed W-8BEN-E (PDF) plus the Certificate of Status (COI) for the foreign entity, and a statement of where services were performed. Depending on the chapter 3/4 status on the W-8BEN-E we may need additional withholding documentation.

Additional items that speed things up:
- Beneficial owner attestation (one-liner) if payments route through a US affiliate.
- Bank letter or voided check on ACH form for validation.

Timeline: once we receive a complete set (form + bank details + COI or EIN), Finance typically validates within 48–72 business hours and releases payment the next ACH run. If anything looks like it triggers backup withholding we will flag — otherwise SLA is 3 business days after validation.

I can prepare a DocuSign bundle (W-9 or W-8 and ACH form). Alex — if you want to confirm payee entity in writing we can send the correct bundle.

Regards,
